episode_title: How Feelings Turn Customers Into Fans with Stacy Sherman

real_qa.q: What gap did Stacey Sherman discover in her customer experience research study?
real_qa.r: Stacey discovered that companies are designing experiences based on logic and transactions, but customers are buying emotionally. There is a real gap: companies care about customer experience with technology and teams, yet they are losing profitable customers because they are not doing CX right, and her research proves how to close this gap.
real_qa.requete: Stacey Sherman customer experience research gap

real_qa.q: Why do emotions matter more than customer satisfaction scores in business success?
real_qa.r: Emotions is the experience. When interacting with a company, our brains think and feel simultaneously, but it is the feeling that leaves the lasting imprint and determines what we do next—whether we return, tell others, or write bad reviews. Companies must measure emotions, not just satisfaction or Net Promoter Score, because data shows emotions drive buying decisions.

real_qa.q: How can companies align internal teams to deliver consistent emotional customer experiences across different personas and touchpoints?
real_qa.r: Start by bringing HR, IT, product, sales, and marketing together to decide what emotion customers should feel when thinking of and interacting with the brand—everyone initially gives different answers. Once aligned internally on that one emotion, evaluate what customers actually say about you through voice of customer insights, not just surveys, to detect structured and unstructured sentiments people express about your brand.
real_qa.requete: align teams customer experience emotional consistency

real_qa.q: What is the alternative metric to NPS that businesses should measure to understand true customer loyalty?
real_qa.r: Instead of only focusing on NPS, measure the emotional altitude at moments of truth—asking at critical interactions how it felt to interact with a customer service agent or walk out of a store with a product. This emotional metric is what people are ignoring, yet research shows people buy emotionally, so ignoring emotion measurement is a big mistake.
real_qa.requete: NPS alternative emotional metrics customer loyalty

real_qa.q: How did a telecom company prevent customer frustration by redesigning their Buy Online Pickup at Store experience?
real_qa.r: By collecting voice of customer insights, they discovered that while buying online was easy, customers were frustrated having to wait in line at the store for a sales rep to retrieve their already-paid phone. They created a separate express queue for pickup-only customers and enabled sales reps to personalize recommendations by device type, preventing public complaints and returns.
real_qa.requete: Buy Online Pickup Store customer experience redesign
